content: Best to insert all 3 nuts here.  Doing it later after the heat bed is reinstalled just doesn't make any sense.  If they are loose, just put a little blue painters table across them until the screws are installed.
Do not push the nuts in very hard. I had some layer separation while pushing nut in. Part Seemed very weak.
be careful to not over tighten! the nut skips easily in the center hole
Agreed put in  all 3 nuts now and use tape to keep them in place if they are loose.   Mine were all tight.
I would put all three nuts in the bottom of the bed-cable-cover-bottom now since its easier to do while not attached to the heatbed.
Use the pull-through method to seat the nut to protect pulling the nut into place while the screw is against the heatbed.
